title: Script hub
features:
Script Hub is now available in its public beta release. This is an early version, so some features are still under development and may temporarily show as "Soon...".

✨ Currently available:

• Script publishing

• Script browsing and search

• Improved server communication

• Better stability and performance

⚠️ Beta Notice:

You may encounter bugs, visual issues, or unfinished features. If you find any problems, please report them — your feedback helps improve Script Hub faster.

🔧 More features and updates are coming soon.

⚠️ This is NOT a game script hub where pre-made scripts are simply loaded. This platform is community-driven — players upload, share, discover and use scripts created by other users. Browse scripts, publish your own creations, rate content and explore the community.
